author: Stahly
description:
Waaagh! War on Armageddon rumbles on, and followers of Gork and Mork have never had it so good. Across this mega Ork wave we get multipart Boyz back after years of monopose stopgaps, updated Trukks and Warbikers, a brand-new Warboss dripping in customisation, the long-awaited return of Nazdreg Ug Urgub, and more. In this review, we tear open every box, work through the build options kit by kit, and show you high-res sprue images so you know exactly what bitz you're getting before you commit.

The post Da big Orks review: new Warboss, Boyz, Trukks, Warbikers, Mek & Nazdreg unboxed appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Da big Orks review: new Warboss, Boyz, Trukks, Warbikers, Mek & Nazdreg unboxed
